crossRefs.note: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: She said, “The glory has departed from Israel; for God’s ark has been taken.”
translations.bsb: “The glory has departed from Israel,” she said, “for the ark of God has been captured.”
translations.kjv: And she said, The glory is departed from Israel: for the ark of God is taken.
translations.asv: And she said, The glory is departed from Israel; for the ark of God is taken.
